styleLock.direction: bold flat colour-block sports nutrition commerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: flat single colour planes: cobalt #2E6FD0 for statement, spec and close screens, cocoa #6B4630 for flavour and product panels, seamless pure white #FFFFFF only on the packshot; no scenery, no gradient mesh
styleLock.lightingSystem: even high-key graphic light with a front-left key and soft fill, one soft contact shadow per object, no falloff or vignette; skimming side light only on the texture macro
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless colour planes plus one warm off-white paper panel #F2EDE4; no wood, no marble, no fabric tabletop
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family, oversized statement band plus short label bars, all real wording composited in post so the render only carries blank type blocks
styleLock.iconSystem: single-weight thin rules, empty pill button blocks and blank seal frames in accent #B6CC2E, no pictograms and no badges
styleLock.presentationRules: bottle held at a stable slight 3/4 or a flat 90-degree side profile with identical scale and label placement across screens, never covered by props, always grounded by its own contact shadow
noDrift: no mixed fonts or serif lettering
no gradient mesh, glow or 3D stage effects
no filled-in numbers, units or badges inside blank blocks
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent bold flat colour-block sports nutrition visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cobalt #2E6FD0, cocoa brown #6B4630, warm off-white #F2EDE4 and one lime accent #B6CC2E; cool even high-key graphic lighting with a front-left key, soft fill and one soft contact shadow per object; flat single colour planes as the only background system, one warm off-white paper panel for information screens; one modern geometric sans-serif family with oversized statement bands and short label bars, all wording left as blank blocks for post compositing; thin single-weight rules, empty pill button blocks and blank seal frames only; stable slight 3/4 or flat side-profile product angle and identical product scale; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no gradient mesh or glow, no filled numbers or badges inside blank blocks.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：01 白底整托加前置单瓶；02 钴蓝纯色场居中两行大字带；03 上蓝下棕双色块中的两块断裂巧克力；04 钴蓝底超大数值字加右下角巧克力块；05 左棕右蓝竖向分屏，单瓶正侧影配超大数值文字块；06 顶部蓝带大字主张加左下斜置瓶特写加右侧人物抬瓶即饮；07 钴蓝底居中标题、细下划线与整段说明文字；08 左蓝右棕分屏，左侧奶白参数表格加下方说明块、右侧单瓶正影。品类判定：源图与提示均为瓶装开盖即饮的巧克力风味蛋白饮品，属冲调饮品类食品而非粉末冲剂或营养补充剂，故定 L1 食品饮料、L2 饮料，与提示类目一致；未判医药保健因源图无胶囊片剂形态、按瓶装饮品售卖。已剥离内容：原品牌字标、系列名、奶牛图形标识、店铺与平台徽标与星级角标、全部英文原句文案、源图上的克数与瓶数与容量等营养与规格数值、配料表与营养成分表的具体文字与数字、人物面容与身份特征；数值与主张一律改为空白标题带、空数值格、空表格单元与空按钮框，仅保留撞色分屏版面结构本身。
